text:
alan: Originating RC rc-21z (tag rc-21z). Build 948. Artifacts pushed: registry:redwood/inference:rc-21z and s3://ci/rc-948/. Requesting ops pin, KV warm, and quiet window 19:30-20:30 UTC. Plan: small canary then step.

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-21z created (build 948). Artifacts uploaded. K V warm job queued id=kv-948.

rita: Quick staging pass done. Noticed two failing regen tests (edge-case prompts) but they pass on stable. Added a small tolerance fix to the eval harness; not blocking promo but logged.

cheng: From infra: recommend node affinity to low-latency racks and soft-circuit at 1% error. Prepared rollback snippet and holdback image. Rollback commands: 
```
# quick rollback to last stable image
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-10 -n prod
# reset traffic shim
curl -X POST "$DEPLOY_API/traffic/revert" -d '{"target":"stable"}'
# deploy-bot rollback
deploy-bot rollback --id rc-21z --reason "ops-rollback"
```

ops-sheriff: I'm on-call for the window and will be primary. I'll be at console 19:20 UTC and will cut traffic at error >1.5% or any GPU OOM.

deploy-bot: [kv-warm] started for rc-21z: warming ~820k keys, threads=6
[log] 40% complete...
[log] finished in 2m 7s, cache 880MB

alan: Canary plan: start at 0.7% for 12m; if p95 < 160ms and errors < 0.6% then step to 7% for 20m; then 50% for 15m. Final promote and artifact pin if green. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/rc-21z. Please monitor token-cost and model memory. Model pin request: v2.5.0-rc0 (quant=q5-2026-03).

rita: Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/rc-21z.md. Short note about minor output variance and migration tip added.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary 0.7% -> rc-21z at 2026-03-21T19:30:05Z. Initial metrics: p95=142ms, errors=0.07%, cpu=49%, gpu=41%

cheng: Holding 12m. Watching autoscaler and eviction logs.

ops-sheriff: All quiet so far. No alarms.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 7% complete at 2026-03-21T19:43:30Z. Monitoring: p95=147ms, errors=0.11%

alan: Seeing small token-cost delta (~2.1%) at 7% due to a subset of prompts generating longer completions. Within threshold. Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% started at 2026-03-21T20:05:12Z.

rita: At 50% hold metrics look stable (p95=153ms, errors=0.14%). No GPU memory issues.

cheng: Ready for final promote if no regressions. Rollback snippet staged and team on standby.

ops-sheriff: Approving final promote. I'll maintain watch for 30m post-promo.

alan: Promoting to 100% and pinning artifacts now: registry:redwood/inference:rc-21z and model:v2.5.0-rc0 (quant=q5-2026-03).

deploy-bot: [deploy] promote -> 100% at 2026-03-21T20:22:40Z. Final metrics snapshot: p95=156ms, errors=0.12%, token-cost uplift=2.6%, cpu=63%, gpu=49%

release-coordinator: Promotion complete. Sending release email and updating release notes. Will open follow-up if customers report issues.

rita: Locking rc-21z as promoted in the release docket. Thanks all. :tada:
